writeup: TIC 229146166 is a candidate eclipsing binary star detected in TESS photometry with an orbital period of 3.990257 days and a primary eclipse depth of 15.43 percent dimming. The detection shows a strong automated signal with a BLS signal-to-noise ratio of 446.3, and pixel-level image analysis confirms the eclipsing signature at the target location with a difference-imaging peak signal-to-noise of 46.2. However, the data exhibits a notable quirk: alternating eclipses differ significantly in depth, which may indicate systematic effects in the observations. The candidate does not appear in six major variable-star catalogs, making it potentially novel. No secondary eclipse was detected in the available data.
